messages:
Sasha: Hey — trying to pull model-health + traces for asia-prod (apac1) for last 24h. dashboard link? I get 403 on grafana. Anyone have shortlink? :wave:

Devon: @Sasha looks like you don't have the "observability:viewer" role in the apac project. Which dashboard are you trying?

Sasha: The model health one (service/model-serving-overview) + traces for model-gateway. Grafana link I tried: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/model-health?orgId=1 403

Observability-bot: Shortlinks: model health (apac) https://grafana.redwood.ai/s/mdl-apac , traces (apac) https://traces.redwood.ai/s/apac-models . If you hit 403, open a perms request here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-ACCESS

Jun: @Devon can you add Sasha to the apac-observers group? I just added a couple people last week.

Devon: Yep — I can. @Sasha I'll add you to apac-observers, should propagate in ~5m. If still 403, try incognito. Also FYI, for traces use the service filter: `service:model-gateway-apac` and timeframe `now-24h`.

Sasha: thanks, trying now.

Sasha: still 403 after 10m. Devon, pinged the perms pipeline? :thinking_face:

Devon: Hm — looks like the group sync failed on last deploy. Re-running group-sync now. ETA 2m.

Observability-bot: group-sync job started (job id gs-2026-03-17-11). Will post when done.

Observability-bot: group-sync job completed — added sasha to apac-observers. You'll need to sign out/in.

Sasha: confirmed — access granted, can view dashboards :tada: Links working.

Liz: Quick note — while you're looking at model-health, can you confirm token drop alert thresholds? They seem noisy for short tails. Maybe bump to 0.5% for apac-prod.

Devon: Good catch. @Liz can you open an alert-tuning PR? I can shepherd it through oncall review. Use path `ops/alerts/model-token-drop.yaml` and change `threshold: 0.5` and add `window: 10m`.

Liz: Will do, creating PR now. cc @oncall

Sasha: also, any quick way to get raw logs for a specific request id? Got a bad sample: req=abc123

Jun: Use Loki query: `req_id="abc123"` in the apac tailing view. Short link: https://loki.redwood.ai/l/apac?query=req_id%3D%22abc123%22

Sasha: perfect, thanks everyone :rocket:

Devon: marking thread resolved — will follow up on alert PR.

Sasha: closing — much appreciated.
